concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 3B (plasma); Fig. 3D (tumour vs contralateral signal over time)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: The pharmacokinetics of the peptides were determined following intravenous injection of the biotinylated peptides into mice and measurement via ELISA of blood samples
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 3B plots the percentage of peptide remaining in plasma against time after a single i.v. injection, with the 1-minute sample set to 100%; the y-axis is therefore percent-of-initial rather than absolute concentration, which is why no Cmax or AUC can be derived. Fig. 3D plots NIR fluorescence signal intensity in tumour and contralateral normal tissue over time up to 24 h.

bioanalytical_method: Streptavidin-HRP/TMB ELISA of biotinylated peptide captured from diluted plasma (absorbance at 450 nm); near-infrared fluorescence imaging with CF750-labelled peptide on an IVIS Optical Imaging System for biodistribution
bioanalytical_quote: the retained peptides in plasma were directly detected using HRP-streptavidin and TMB substrate as described above
notes: Abstract was fenced and was not used; both half-life values are independently restated in the body (Results 3.3 and Discussion), so they are body-sourced. NO Cmax, tmax or AUC is reported anywhere in the body. The plasma ELISA readout is explicitly normalised ("The absorbance of the sample collected at 1 min was considered to be 100%"), so the study never produced absolute plasma concentrations and no Cmax could exist. NO absorption half-life and no rate constant are reported; the authors give only a single "circulating half-life" with no named phase, so half_life_phase is "unspecified" and half_life_elimination is left "not reported" rather than inferred. The BB28 value is a censored upper bound ("less than 5 min") and is recorded verbatim as such. Peptides used in the PK study were N-terminally biotinylated so that they could be captured by streptavidin-HRP; this label is noted in the sequence fields. Terminal fluorescence scanning of excised organs at 24 h is a biodistribution readout on tissue from dosed animals rather than an ex vivo incubation, so "ex vivo" was not added as a study type even though the figure legend uses that word. B28 (GGLRSLGRKILRAWKKYG) and the ABD heptapeptide WQRPSSW are named in the body as building blocks but were not themselves dosed or assayed as standalone agents, so they are not listed as separate agent objects. Cytotoxicity IC50 values (micromolar) are rendered in this PDF text with "mM" where "uM" is meant, an extraction artefact of the mu character; the IC50 numbers are not PK parameters and were not used for any PK field.
